research_find.title: 9/21 EMA Crossover on MNQ — Why the Confirmation Bar Matters
research_find.description: Walk-forward analysis of a 9/21 EMA crossover on Micro Nasdaq (MNQ) 15-minute bars from 2018 to 2024 shows that adding a 2-bar confirmation requirement after the cross reduces whipsaws by 38% with only an 8% reduction in total trades captured. The strategy targets trending sessions identified by ADX above 25 and uses a 2.0 ATR trailing stop with break-even-at-1R. RTH only. Profit factor 1.93, Sharpe 1.71, max drawdown $1,840 on a 50K simulated account. The author notes the edge is concentrated in the 10:00 ET to 14:00 ET window when institutional trend-followers are active.
